text: Hi, what can I do for you? I wanted to talk to you about the possibility of getting a minor in the Spanish department. Sure, what do you want to know? I was wondering what the requirements are and what courses I would need to take. Well, typically six classes are required to fulfill the minor, including the language courses. Do you have any classes in mind that you’re interested in taking? Yes, I definitely want to take the Spanish Linguistics class. That sounds like a great fit for you. Have you taken any Spanish literature classes? Not yet, but I would be interested in that, too. Okay, that’s a good start. In your case, you would need to take our Advanced Spanish Language course and three additional content courses. These classes are related to Hispanic cultures, literature, or linguistics. That sounds doable. Thank you for your help!
